lesson.uz:
Declare bloki nom va turni belgilaydi. Integer — butun son, Real — kasr son, String — matn, Boolean — True yoki False. Assign qiymatni saqlaydi: total = price * count.
Avval e’lon qiling, so‘ng qiymat bering, oxirida Output qiling. O‘zgaruvchi nomida bo‘sh joy ishlatmang. Bu mavzudagi sonlar shartda beriladi; Input qo‘shmang. Qiymat o‘zgarganda eski qiymatning o‘rniga yangisi yoziladi.
lesson.en:
Declare gives a variable its name and type. Integer stores whole numbers, Real decimals, String text, and Boolean True or False. Assign stores a value: total = price * count.
Declare first, assign second, output last. Variable names cannot contain spaces. These tasks supply constants in the statement: do not add Input. An assignment replaces the old value.

text.uz: Shartdagi talab etilgan bloklarga e’tibor bering.
text.en: Check the required blocks in each task.

text.uz: Har bir Input alohida qatorni o‘qiydi. Natijani namuna bilan taqqoslang.
text.en: Each Input reads one line. Compare your output with the examples.

statement.uz: Maktab do‘koni: a=26, b=2 qiymatlarni Declare va Assign bilan saqlang. a+b ifoda natijasini r o‘zgaruvchiga yozib, chiqaring. Input ishlatmang.
statement.en: School shop: Declare and assign a=26, b=2. Store the result of a+b in r and print r. Do not use Input.

outputFormat.uz: So‘ralgan natijalarni berilgan tartibda, har birini alohida qatorda chiqaring. Qo‘shimcha matn chiqarmang.
outputFormat.en: Print the requested results in order, one per line, with no extra text.
